evidence.observedFact: The active booking page lists current Mentor hours and states that forgotten or cancelled appointments prevent the business from filling appointment time and prevent waiting-list clients from receiving requested services.
The business says appointments may be booked months in advance, sends confirmations and reminders, and charges a 50% fee for same-day cancellations or no-shows before a client can book again.
The current service menu includes repeatable waxing, facial, massage, spray-tan and add-on services, and some new-client services require deposits.

gaps.recommendedFix: Demonstrate a cancellation-recovery and waitlist-fill workflow that converts released appointment slots into rebooked visits.
Demonstrate automated rebooking and service-cycle reminders for clients who miss, cancel, or become overdue for repeatable services.

recommendedEntryOffer: Cancellation Recovery + Waitlist Reactivation Revenue Engine
notes: Observed fact: the business explicitly describes forgotten appointments, waiting-list displacement, same-day/no-show fees, long booking lead times, and repeatable services. Hypothesis: an automated recovery and reactivation layer could improve utilization and repeat visits. No monetary loss is estimated.
